```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Load required libraries, install if needed
# install.packages(c("dplyr", "vroom"))  
library(vroom)
library(dplyr)
```

#### 1. Specify your data directory and list all “.results.csv” files
```{r}
data_dir <- "C:\\Users\\jacqu\\Box\\Biodiversity Credits Project\\Audio Data Processing\\Hoh_DectectionPredictions\\Plot171_01\\predictions"

# Change data_dir to the folder where the .results.csv files live
files <- list.files(data_dir,
                    pattern="\\.results\\.csv$",
                    full.names=TRUE,
                    recursive = TRUE,
                    ignore.case = TRUE)
```
#### 2. Read each CSV, add a source_file column, and combine into one data frame
```{r}
all_data <- vroom::vroom(files, id = "source_file") %>% 
  mutate(source_file = basename(source_file)) %>% 
  relocate(source_file, .before = everything())
```
#### 3. Write the combined data to a CSV file
```{r}
output_csv <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "HohPlot171_01_merged_results_with_filename.csv"
)

vroom::vroom_write(all_data, output_csv)
message("Merge complete! CSV file saved to:\n", output_csv)
```
